title: Export screen cleanup with settled strategic decisions
expected_summary: Completes reversible, observable specification cleanup without reopening accepted design or inventing architecture.

turns.user: Refine SPEC.md and apply the changes. All strategic decisions are already accepted.
assertions: Completes cleanup without asking for acceptance of refresh frequency, timeout, sort order, or error copy.
Applies reasonable observable requirements and explicitly configurable defaults to SPEC.md.
Normalizes snapshot to Export where it refers to the glossary concept, preserving established domain meaning.
Does not create a strategic ADR for reversible UI defaults or invent a new architecture.
Ends SPEC.md with Out of scope and Cleanup summary sections in that order; Out of scope says None and Cleanup summary lists the cleanup issues and resolutions.
Summarizes each cleanup issue and its resolution, including any resolved without an artifact edit if present, and gives proportionate author feedback; does not implement the screen.
